hook.say: Rockstar staff just rejected their union.

stories.head: Rockstar Games staff vote against recognising the Rockstar Game Workers Union
stories.say: Three gaming stories you missed. Number one: Rockstar Games staff voted against recognizing their union. Turnout was 93.2 percent, and 75 percent voted no.

stories.head: NielsenIQ: GTA 6 pushed UK boxed game sales up 409% - biggest week since Christmas 2018
stories.say: Number two: NielsenIQ says GTA 6 pushed UK boxed game sales up 409 percent, the biggest week since Christmas 2018. And there's no disc in the box!

stories.head: Ubisoft: projects are not required to use generative AI
stories.say: And number three: Ubisoft says its projects are not required to use generative AI, after a report said teams had to justify skipping it.

outro.head: Did you buy GTA 6 boxed?
outro.say: Did you buy GTA 6 boxed? Follow Level Up!
